governing_standard: W33 Golden Learning & Assessment Standard v1.0

findings.title: Canonical Audio Generator Contains Hardcoded Learner-Facing Spoken Strings
findings.root_cause: read_social.mp3 (line 174), exam_intro_L1..S4 (lines 203-211), and info_exchange_q1..q4 (lines 222-225) are hardcoded as string literals rather than imported dynamically from data hubs or blueprints.
findings.remediation_plan: Refactor info_exchange_q1..q4 to read from speaking_hub.js; create formal hub export for read_social.mp3; document blueprint template strings.

findings.title: Physical MP3 Assets Lack Cryptographic Provenance to Canonical Generator
findings.root_cause: scripts/generate_w33_audio_canonical.mjs was newly created in Step 1G but never executed against live TTS API. Physical MP3s on disk were generated between Aug 25-28 by legacy scripts.
findings.evidence: Physical file modification timestamps in public/audio/week33/ are Aug 25-28; W33_AUDIO_GENERATION_MANIFEST.json does not exist on disk.
findings.remediation_plan: Mark GENERATOR-PROVENANCE = UNVERIFIED. Run canonical generator with live API key when authorized by Strategic Reviewer to establish verifiable generation manifest.

findings.title: Unprotected Competing Generator Scripts Can Overwrite Production Audio
findings.root_cause: Step 1G deprecated only 3 legacy scripts, leaving 5 active generator scripts capable of synthesizing and overwriting public/audio/week33/ MP3 files.
findings.evidence: All 5 scripts are currently executable and write directly to public/audio/week33/.
findings.remediation_plan: Convert remaining legacy generator scripts into fail-closed deprecation wrappers.

findings.title: Manifest Builder Depends on Deprecated Generator for Social Studies Story
findings.root_cause: scripts/build_w33_audio_manifest.mjs imports STATIC_AUDIO_TASKS from deprecated tools/generate_w33_all_audio.mjs for read_social.mp3 because no social story hub file exists in week_33.
findings.remediation_plan: Relocate canonical social story text to an authoritative data hub export and update manifest builder import.

findings.title: Golden Freeze Spec and Manifest Hashes Mutated Without Formal Amendment
findings.root_cause: docs/GATE15_SPEC_W33.json assertion for weekly_review was modified in Step 1G to align with Speaking S1 routing, and its hash in W33_GOLDEN_FREEZE_MANIFEST.json was rewritten inline without formal amendment logging.
findings.evidence: git log -p -1 docs/W33_GOLDEN_FREEZE_MANIFEST.json shows hash update from da5f312e... to c30e8d05....
findings.remediation_plan: Formalize AMENDMENT-W33-FREEZE-001 in W33_CLOSURE_LEDGER.md with explicit Strategic Reviewer authorization.
